messages.text:
We need a bit or style work for the write-up and consistency:

- can you write a set of colors for beampipe / pixel / short strip / long strip / ecal / hcal / fcal / muons / magnet system as a ruleset (make an infrastructure PR):



colors are:



beampipe: **#ffcc66**

pixels: **#0066cc**

short strips: **#ff9933**

long strips: **#009999**

ecal: **#cccc00**

hcal: **#663311**

fcal: **#99ccff**

muon: **#0066ff**

magnets: **#999999**



Put this on the Readme mainpage, and make a rule that if specific aspects are shown, e.g. stacked histograms of the specified components they would be plotted in the respective color.
I’ll add the component colors and plotting rule to the main README, then prepare an infrastructure PR using the repository’s conventions.

I found the nODD repository and its infrastructure conventions. I’ll put the palette on the main README and link it from the contributor rules so future component plots—including stacked histograms—use the same colors.

The README now contains all nine exact hex values. The rules require matching colors and legends across figures and component subsets, with an explicit stacked-histogram example. I’ve also linked the palette from the contributor rules and TDR writing guide.
The palette and links check out, and the required session validation and token-dashboard build passed. I’m preparing the PR now, including the repository’s required session and interaction records.
The branch is pushed. The GitHub connector lacks permission to create PRs in this repository, so I’m using the configured GitHub CLI to open it.
[PR #112](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/112) is open. The required interaction record and local checks pass; I’m pushing the final record update and marking the PR ready for review.

Created [Infrastructure PR #112](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/112), ready for review.

- Added all nine exact colors to the main README.
- Required consistent component and legend colors, including stacked histograms.
- Linked the rules from contributor guidance and the TDR writing guide.

Palette/link checks, session and interaction validation, and the dashboard build passed. Hosted CI has not reported yet.
